nodes.label: TODO: Scope Sleep Commits Around Raw Transcripts
nodes.rationale: Sleep versions the whole store including raw transcripts that may hold secrets; until commits are scoped or scrubbed, any store repository is treated as sensitive.

nodes.label: TODO: Executor-Owned Agent Loop
nodes.rationale: Host-CLI boundary distillation costs 80-100s per boundary; an executor loop with native tool use, persisted traces and a durable job queue would replace the fire-and-forget launch while the host CLI stays the zero-key fallback.

nodes.label: TODO: recall --explain Score Breakdown
nodes.rationale: Today --json carries one opaque combined score; exposing per-signal and BM25-vs-vector breakdown serves both users and external debuggers.

nodes.label: TODO: Recall Confidence Gate
nodes.rationale: Label weak answers 'reformulate the query' when the top candidate is far from the request, gating over abstract and body rather than title only.

nodes.label: TODO: Maintenance Candidate Taxonomy in Sleep Reports
nodes.rationale: Deterministic candidate ids per problem kind keep a candidate stable across passes so a decision binds to the same entity.

nodes.label: TODO: Link Proposals from Sleep
nodes.rationale: When sleep finds related memories it should file a T1 proposal instead of silently writing the link, preserving explicit-links governance.

nodes.label: TODO: OpenCode Positional Watermark Risk
nodes.rationale: Shape-shifting history can shift positions so items are missed or duplicated with no content check; a content-aware watermark is a core change deferred until observed.

nodes.label: TODO: Live Muse Sandbox and Portability Preflight
nodes.rationale: Muse hook, MCP and sandbox behavior plus Muse-Codex portability pairs must be observed on an authenticated build before the full four-host matrix.
